title: MS60026: Industrial Polymer Production Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: None
Processing technology : introduction, mixing, blending, extrusion, calendaring,
molding, coating, bonding metal/powder, building-hand/spray lay up, forming,
vulcanizing/curing-steam, LCM, fluidised bed, continuous, composite making,
finishing. Compounding technology : introduction, formulations, ingredient
selection, sequence of ingredient addition - its science and technology.
Production technology: General purpose O rings, seals, bushes, tapes, blown
films, cellular products, hot water bag, ice bag, battery containers,
decorative laminates, resin based composites, etc. Engineering products antivibration mountings, bumper guards, shock absorber, axle blocks, dock
fenders, bridge bearings, etc. Industrial products - beltings, hoses,
footwears, cables, sports goods. Automobile products: tyres of cycle, rickshaw,
two wheelers, three wheelers, cars, passengers, trucks, earth movers, giant
tyres, tyre design and construction. Industrial quality control, industrial
trouble shooting, destructive and non-destructive testing, case study.
